name: Piper FastAPI Wrapper (TTS Bridge)
description: Piper FastAPI Wrapper (TTS bridge) - wraps a Piper Wyoming TCP server as a simple HTTP REST API. Endpoints: GET /health, GET /voices (filtered by VOICE_LANGUAGES), POST /tts -> audio/wav (streaming). Point PIPER_HOST/PIPER_PORT at an existing Piper server (default 192.168.100.112:10200) and set a default VOICE.

variables.name: Piper Host
variables.description: Hostname/IP of the Piper Wyoming server.

variables.name: Piper Port
variables.description: Port of the Piper Wyoming server.

variables.name: Default Voice
variables.description: Default voice name used by /tts when none specified.

variables.name: Voice Language Filter
variables.description: Comma-separated language filter for /voices. Empty = list all (44+ languages). Prefix match: vi also matches vi_VN.

variables.name: API Port
variables.description: HTTP port this bridge listens on.
